**Verify:** test -f code-swarm/skills/swarm/swarm.schema.json && echo OK

**Files:** code-swarm/skills/swarm/swarm.schema.json (app block); code-swarm/agents/pr-verifier.md (lens); code-swarm/skills/swarm/SKILL.md + swarm.js (plumb app into CONV)
